mentions.name: Obsidian-powered SvelteKit personal site
mentions.description: A personal site built with SvelteKit that combines a blog with a public project tracker. All site content is written and edited in Obsidian, and a build script parses the markdown in the vault when the site is built, letting the author document upcoming projects.
mentions.audience: Wanted a place to document several new projects planned for next year
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m (possibly) over-engineering a new personal site using SvelteKit. It’s a blog + public project tracker. All the site content is created and edited using Obsidian, and there’s a build script that parses all the markdown in the vault when the site is built. I’m planning on working on several new projects next year and wanted a place to document them
